summary: Iter 227 — Backend + Frontend verification of Integrator 'Clientes Instalados' feature (installed-clients endpoint + PDF export + hover tooltip subsection). All backend cross-filter/exclusion/case-insensitive/name-match/404 tests pass; frontend hover popover renders the section with count, client rows, Exportar a PDF (triggers PDF download) and preserves Contacto Principal regression fields.

issues: React hydration warnings (span child of <tr>, span nested) surfaced in console on /integrators. Not caused by this feature but present in the app; suggest a follow-up review.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/integrators.py: OK — _installed_clients_for_integrator uses proper $or with $regex ^...$ (case-insensitive, escaped). Excludes _id. Raises 404 on missing integrator.

IntegratorContactHover.jsx: lazy fetch via onOpenChange; export button disabled while empty/loading — good UX. Blob download uses URL.revokeObjectURL. All required data-testid present (installed-clients-section-<id>, installed-clients-export-<id>, installed-client-row-<i>, installed-clients-empty, installed-clients-loading).
PDF endpoint uses services.pdf_report.build_corporate_pdf with 4 columns and correct title including Integrador + Aplicación. Content-Disposition attachment; filename sanitized.
seed_data_creation: QATEST_ prefixed data created and DELETED at end (both backend pytest cleanup and post-frontend cleanup). Verified 0 leftover integrators and 0 leftover clients with the QATEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Backend endpoint GET /api/integrators/{id}/installed-clients returns {integrator_name, app_name, count, clients:[rif, legal_name, fantasy_name, condicion]}. PDF endpoint returns valid %PDF with attachment header. 404 when integrator not found. Frontend /integrators shows the popover subsection with data-testid installed-clients-section-<id>, installed-client-row-<i>, installed-clients-export-<id>. Note (unrelated): app-wide React hydration warnings visible in console; not caused by this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Verified: (1) client A (id-match + AppY) LISTED; (2) client B (id-match + AppZ) EXCLUDED; (3) client C (name-match with different case + case-insensitive AppY) LISTED; (4) 404 on unknown integrator; (5) PDF endpoint returns 200 with %PDF header and correct content-disposition; (6) tooltip popover on /integrators renders Contacto Principal + Clientes Instalados (count=1) + Exportar a PDF button; (7) PDF download event captured for the download filename clientes_instalados_<safe_name>.pdf.
notes_on_label_check: During frontend test, initial 'in' string check reported False for some Spanish labels because the UI applies CSS uppercase-transform (e.g. TELÉFONO, EMAIL, CONTACTO PRINCIPAL, NEGOCIA INTERFAZ). Visually all fields render correctly (see screenshot iter227_popover.png).
